But there were green shoots for investors as Hyundai kept its annual guidance unchanged. It said it plans to boost production and launch new models in the second half. Hyundai further said it expects growth to continue in the third and fourth quarter. Although some analysts warned it would be challenging for Hyundai to achieve its full-year operating margin target of 6.3%-7.3%. They blamed that on difficult market conditions. Growing competition in its key European market from new Chinese competitors hit growth at some of its brands.
